text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, while talking with 
Biwa Hayahide in the central courtyard—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you guys! Have you seen Brian around?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen her today, though... What 
happened? Did something happen to my 
sister?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah, it's really not a big deal! I 
just forgot to give you the bento I made.
choice_data_list: You made a bento for Narita Brian?
You're making a bento for Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. She's super picky and only ever 
wants to eat the same specific things!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I just can't leave them alone, you see. So 
I make it for them once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry as always, Hishiama-kun. My 
sister's picky eating is truly 
deep-rooted...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Back in the day, I used to put extra 
effort into making curry as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If there's even a hint of vegetable 
flavor, they'll stop eating, so it took a 
lot of trial and error..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Chop the vegetables finely, stew them 
thoroughly— and whenever it turned out 
just the way she liked, she always asked 
for seconds...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Oh, wow. Even Brian had a spoiled 
brat phase like that, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's a story from long ago, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, far from home-cooked meals... even 
the opportunities to share the same dinner 
table have grown scarce.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If it's your cooking, wouldn't Sis still 
gladly eat it even now? Why don't you make 
something for her for old times' sake?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No... our relationship has changed as 
well. Things can't go back to the way they 
were."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian and I have different rooms, and 
barging in suddenly with food might just 
be a nuisance to her—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Aaargh! This is so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Move your hands before you waste time 
brooding over it! You can think about what 
to do next after giving it everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, we're cooking after 
school! Meet up at the cafeteria kitchen, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: See ya!! You better show up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't even have time to argue back.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... I cannot simply ignore this. I 
have no choice but to go, do I...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna whip up a super tasty 
home-cooked meal and blow Brian away with 
my cooking!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... But what on earth should I make, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, could I get your opinion on 
the training regimen...?
choice_data_list: A nutritious curry packed with energy

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Treating them to a taste of 
memories, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Making curry was a long time ago. I 
probably don't remember the taste that 
well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...However, curry is not a bad choice. It 
allows you to get vegetables, meat, and 
carbs all in one dish."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the recipe from back then on 
hand, but I'll try to recreate the flavor 
as closely as possible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Alright, it's complete!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's quite curious. Even though it's been 
years, my body remembered exactly what to 
do once I actually started making it.
choice_data_list:
Looks like all that hard work from back 
then really stuck with you.

Looks like all that hard work from back 
then really stayed with you, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that might be true.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What a nostalgic scent.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Brian!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So it really was Big Sis's curry 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
May I have a bowl? I was just feeling a 
little peckish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. That's Big Sis's curry, all right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Seconds, please.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ...What's with that spoiled look on 
your face?

Watching her younger sister eat the curry, 
Biwa Hayahide smiled with relief and joy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Stamina is essential for building a robust 
body. ...Maybe I'll make hamburger steaks.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Dishes other than curry, huh... I suppose 
I occasionally made Salisbury steak too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I secretly kneaded vegetables into it, 
Brian would eat it without noticing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I do that all the time too! As long 
as you fake the shape and the taste, it 
works out somehow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That Brian is surprisingly simple about 
things like that—

Engaged in conversation like neighbors 
chatting by the well, the two skillfully 
prepared the meal. And then—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the vegetable-packed "Stealth 
Hamburg Steak" is complete!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I mixed plenty into the hamburg 
steak itself, and into the sauce as well—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You sure look like you're having fun, Big 
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian!? What are you doing here...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ama-san called me over. I don't really get 
it, but is there something you wanted to 
feed me?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I know it's none of my business, 
but... I really want your hard work to pay 
off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what am I going to do with 
you... Fine, I get it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, delicious. Meat really is the 
best. It gives you strength.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh. ...Heheh, it worked out after all, 
Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What is it, you two?

Afterward, I watched over Narita Brian as 
she finished every single bite of her 
Salisbury steak.
